## About Me {#about-me}

I am currently pursuing my Ph.D. degree at Tianjin University.

## Research Interests {#research-interests}

- **AI Security** — adversarial attacks and defenses, deep neural network IP protection
- **Multimodal Large Models** — cross-modal understanding, vision-language models
- **Visual Generative Models** — text-to-image diffusion models, identity customization and its safety
